env_exempt_mismatches: max_steps: collection=400 imprint=8 (episode-length knob only: BOTH walkers override max_episode_steps on the STATE (835 _finalize_panel / this module's walk_env), so the config value is inert for the replay)

position_size_pct: collection=0.1 imprint=0.0625 (CONDITIONAL on vector_weight_rebalance being true on BOTH sides (refused otherwise). Under weight-rebalance, step_vector overwrites cash/positions wholesale (jax_trading_env.py:1791-1798), limit legs are sized w_unit*PV (:1785) reserving 0 (:1561), so ideal_trade_value = PV*position_size_pct (:1418) is DEAD CODE. Verified empirically at fixture scale (fix pass): the pinned operator walked at --position-size-pct 0.1 vs 0.0625 gives 1.000 chosen-vector agreement, 1.000 realized-book agreement, net@21 +13.89300020243101 BOTH and final_pv 107485.84375 BOTH, with position_size_pct the ONLY differing env field. The same pair walked with weight-rebalance OFF diverges (net@21 +17.2151 vs +17.1620, final_pv 109773.20 vs 106052.72) — which is exactly why the exemption is CONDITIONAL. Needed because the teacher of record records 0.1 while the pinned imprint manifest (runs/832_e5/jobs_imprint_full.manifest) uses 0.5/64 = 0.0078125 — without this the two pre-registered real legs cannot run together.)

reward_attributable: collection=False imprint=True (TRAJECTORY-inert but NOT consequence-free. It is a reward-only term (jax_trading_env.py:1854): it never touches the state transition, so the recorded action vectors replay to the identical PV path and the identical teacher floor. The 835 harness exposes no flag for it (its panel is always False) while this runner defaults True, so a hard refusal would block the pre-registered real leg. CONSEQUENCE, recorded because the WARN fires on 100% of legitimate pairings and a warning that always fires carries no signal: inject_teacher turns THIS run's reward stream into the MC value targets, so the student's value/reward heads are fit under a reward definition the search teacher never optimised. The POLICY targets (the BC objective this task is about) are unaffected. Pass --no-reward-attributable to align the two definitions.)

floor.why: n=10 seeds (fixture panel, 80 iters): legit min +0.1248 / max +0.3618 / mean +0.2649 / sd 0.0717 vs shuffled min -0.2265 / max -0.0799 / mean -0.1611 / sd 0.0428. Cloud gap 0.2047 (Cohen's d 7.2) — the separation is excellent, the placement was not: at 0.10 the legit margin is only 0.0248 (0.35 sd, ~1% false-FAIL per seed, ~4% over a 4-seed sweep). 0.05 leaves 1.04 sd on the legit side and 3.04 sd on the sabotage side, and still sits above the 0.0 a constant marginal predictor can never beat.

vi_minute_frame_pin.sanity_net21_attribution: FIX PASS — do NOT attribute a swing in this number to the stale tail's tradeability. The stale-tail treatment changes exactly the tail cells of ONE slot; replaying the SAME recorded teacher stream on the filled and zeroed panels isolates that channel and it is SMALL (measured and reported by the (i-b) walk_net21 reconciliation leg of experiments/865_minute_frame_pin/smoke_minute_frame_pin.py, which also carries the sign). A before/after difference in sanity_net21 is dominated by the operator RE-DECIDING on a different panel and by the student being retrained on that different stream — not by the tail becoming tradeable.
